decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certifies that on 27th October 2006, the erection of a single storey side and rear extension to house, as shown on drawings numbered 478/101, 478/102, 478/103, 478/104, and 478/volume calculations, received 27th October 2006, is not lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
Following the proposed extension, consisting of a single storey rear extension, the total volume of extensions to the dwelling would exceed the maximum of 50 cubic metres for a terrace dwelling/Conservation Area, and therefore is not in accordance with the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class A of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the erection of a single storey side and rear extension to house
